title: epicranthes undecifila
intro: Epicranthes undecifila, commonly known as the "Voodoo Lily," is a species of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae, native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Epicranthes undecifila include its ability to reduce inflammation and fight off infections, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
